use_case: Predictive maintenance model for well equipment (rod pumps and ESPs): predicts failures and recommends rod pump speed changes
business_owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted models on the group data platform (SYS-G6) machine learning workspace
data_categories: Historian data (pump cards, motor current, speeds, tank levels); maintenance work orders; no personal data
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only since 2026-09-03: the model recommends, and a production engineer approves any speed change through SCADA. From 2026-06 to 2026-09-03 it changed speeds automatically at 640 Permian wells
applicable_laws: No AI-specific law. Process safety and environmental duties where model actions affect operations (SPCC alarms, 40 CFR 112.9(c)(4)(iv); discharge notice, 40 CFR 110.6); NIST AI RMF 1.0 and SP 800-82 Rev. 3 (voluntary)
status: In production (advisory mode); automatic mode suspended pending conditions
